description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development - Notify the Core Area of the Metro Colombo Development Region as an Urban Development area
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Patali Champika Ranawaka, Minister of Megapolis and Western Development) and detailed descriptions of government responsibilities/portfolios (declaring and developing the Core Area of the Metro Colombo Development Region, specifying the exact composition of municipal councils, urban councils, and pradeshiya sabhas included in this development region). The content includes both "who" (government person) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities/portfolios), making it a Hybrid Gazette.
